name: Inkling
description: Inkling reads your documents with you: streaming summaries, answers that cite the exact page, a check that shows whether a summary is backed by the original, search across your whole library, and podcasts. Next.js, Go, FastAPI, Postgres.

paragraphs: Inkling turns PDFs, Word and PowerPoint files, photos of pages, web pages, recordings and text into streaming summaries, answers questions about one document or your whole library with page-exact citations, checks its own summaries against the original, and can even turn a document into a podcast. A full-stack, three-service application with an e-ink inspired interface: a Next.js frontend, a Go API gateway, and a Python AI service, backed by PostgreSQL.
Live demo · Features · Quick start · Architecture · API · Configuration · Testing

A tour of Inkling: the landing page, a streamed summary in another language, sign-up, a PDF summary with live progress, the check that marks every sentence against the original, the cited page opened with the passage highlighted, chat with citations, a phone photo of a page (HEIC), a scanned PDF, a web link, a Word file, a recording, one question across all documents, two versions of a contract compared, data extracted into a table, a collection overview, a podcast, flashcards, an API key with an expiry and a daily limit and a real call to the API (shown in a terminal), the account page, and…
features: Photos of pages. Signed-in people can attach a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP or an iPhone's HEIC) of a page, or on a phone or tablet press Take a photo to open the camera. The text is read with the same Tesseract OCR as scanned…

Recordings and meetings. Signed-in people can drop in a recording (.mp3, .m4a, .wav, .ogg, .flac, .webm or a .mp4 video, up to 25 MB): it is transcribed with Whisper on Groq (about four cents per hour of audio), then…
Live streaming. Words appear as the model writes them, with real progress ("Summarized 3 of 8 sections") for long documents, and a Cancel button that actually stops the work.
Five styles and 15 languages. Standard, bullet points, executive brief, explain-it-simply, or takeaways with action items, in any of 15 output languages regardless of the source language.
Length control. A word-count slider for short summaries, or a page limit for long documents.
